_comment: Worked example (the Fernwick Skin '5-Step Glassy Matte Skincare Routine' demo). Creative fields — assets.creator_anchor + assets._note_creator + scene_clips.clips[].beat (choices.creator), assets.vanity_world (choices.setting), vo.voice_id + vo.voice_name + vo.source (choices.voice), vo.script + vo.style (choices.tone), music.prompt (choices.music) — come from the recipe's choices; never copy them as defaults. palette + products + cards come from the brand kit / PDPs, not this file. Copy to config.json and edit. A ~32s 9:16 (1080x1920, 30fps) MULTI-SCENE GRWM beauty demo where a locked-identity creator applies 5 Fernwick skincare products step-by-step at a sage vanity, a SEPARATE locked ElevenLabs Karri VO narrates the routine, and every scene cut is snapped to the VO's 'step N' / product-name word-starts (Whisper), with 5 Playwright product overlay cards (PDP-verified taglines) on the product-name beats, a warm acoustic music bed ducked under the VO, clean-white 3-words/cue captions, closing on a gpt-image-2 flat-lay end card. Pipeline: (1) lock creator anchor + sage-vanity world + hook keyframe + Karri VO (atempo 1.15x -> ~27.5s); (2) 7 Seedance 2.0 scene clips (720p, --no-audio) + the flat-lay still; (3) Groq whisper-large-v3 word-level on the VO; (4) re-cut + hard-concat to the 12 VO cuts (build_v4.py, -crf 20 re-encode); (5) 5 white-bg gpt-image-2 product cutouts (PDP-verified taglines) + Playwright cards (render_cards.py); (6) composite cards on the product-name beats (composite_cards.py, -loop 1 -t) + mix VO/music + burn captions + flat-lay end card (build_master.py). Master 1080x1920 h264+aac, ~32s. See scripts/PIPELINE.md for the source scripts.
title: 5 steps, one glassy finish

assets._note_creator: EXAMPLE ONLY (set from choices.creator + choices.setting). Demo creator: 28yo with a dark curly bob, cream terry headband, oatmeal ribbed tank, in a sage-green bathroom. Identity + wardrobe + setting held across every scene clip.
assets._note_hook: Creator holding the ~5 products fanned near the face (demo: 5 frosted sage Fernwick bottles and jars). Doubles as the payoff-smile beat (s07a).

vo._comment: SEPARATE locked ElevenLabs VO (voice from choices.voice, delivery from choices.tone; the demo used Karri) — NOT a native Seedance take. Whispered FIRST; the word-starts set the timeline. atempo 1.15x makes it end at ~27.5s (NOT 45s). Script written clean (no eleven_v3 audio tags).
vo.script: okay, here's my glassy matte skin routine. step one, Rice Toner. it preps my skin before anything else. step two, Peptide Drops. plump and smooth in one drop. step three, Barrier Cream for calm. step four, Blur Primer. it mattes and refines. step five, Daily Veil. that's the shield. five steps, one finish. under three minutes.

_word_starts._comment: Whisper-verified word-starts for this exact atempo'd mp3. Scene cuts snap to the 'step N' starts; cards snap to the product-NAME starts.

scene_clips._beat_rule: beat = THIS brand's product N applied by the creator from choices.creator (soft verbs: dabs / swirls / dusts). The beats below are the Fernwick demo's.
scene_clips._comment: 7 Seedance 2.0 clips (create-video-seedance-fal, Fal direct, 720p, 9:16, --no-audio) off the locked anchor + world. Use soft verbs (dabs / pats / smooths) — hard verbs like 'press' or 'brush her face' can 422 on content policy. All 7 are paid calls.

clips.beat: holds five frosted sage Fernwick bottles and jars fanned near her face, eye contact with selfie camera, playful smile
shakes Rice Toner into her palms, pats it gently over cheeks + forehead with flat hands
squeezes the Peptide Drops dropper, dots three drops on each cheek, smooths them outward with fingertips
scoops a little Barrier Cream from the jar, warms it between fingertips, smooths it over cheeks + jawline
dabs a pea of Blur Primer on her T-zone, taps it in lightly with a ring finger (soft verbs only)
pumps Daily Veil fluid onto two fingers, glides it across her face; skin settles to a soft glassy-matte sheen
smiles fully into the selfie camera, fresh glassy-matte skin, warm confident expression

cuts._comment: 12 cuts derived from the VO word-starts (build_v4.py). Scene cuts land on 'step N' starts; s02 + s03 + s05 sub-cut for pacing. Hard-concat, re-encode -c:v libx264 -crf 20. cuts/10s = 12/32*10 = 3.75.

windows.why: step 1 continuation — ends as 'Peptide Drops' begins
step 2 smoothing — ends as 'step three' begins
step 3 cream — ends as 'step four' begins
step 4 tap-in — ends as 'step five' begins
step 5 glide — ends as 'five steps' payoff begins
payoff smile during 'five steps, one finish'
end-card ken-burns on the flat-lay still

products._comment: 5 white-bg standalone gpt-image-2 cutouts (gen-product-cutouts.sh). Taglines VERIFIED against the fernwickskin.example PDPs — the gpt-image-2 flat-lay renders WRONG sublines on some products, so never read taglines off it. If a Seedance clip renders the packaging in the wrong shape (e.g. a jar where the product is a slim bottle), the card still shows the REAL product.
products._note_taglines: Taglines above are the card lines used in the worked example; ALWAYS re-verify against the live PDP before shipping a new brand — do not carry these forward.

cards._comment: 5 Playwright cards from working/product-card.html.tmpl at 2x scale (render_cards.py): palette.card_bg card + palette.accent bar from the brand kit (demo: pale sage #EEF2EA + fern green #5E8C6A) + cutout thumb + Georgia name + uppercase accent tagline. Composited (composite_cards.py) snapped to the product-NAME word-start (~1s after the scene cut), 1s fade-in. PNG overlays NEED -loop 1 -t <dur>.

music._comment: Instrumental bed from choices.music — prompt below is the demo's warm acoustic pick; skip the bed if the user chose none (ElevenLabs Music, 45s — only ~32s consumed), ducked under the VO. No artist names in the prompt (ElevenLabs ToS filter).
music.prompt: Warm acoustic instrumental, soft nylon guitar + light percussion, gentle and aspirational, easygoing morning-routine energy, no vocals.

audio_mix._comment: The SEPARATE VO is the lead; the music sits well under it. loudnorm I=-14.

captions._comment: Clean-white captions from the VO's Whisper words. OVERRIDE the clean-white preset: 3 words/cue, 3.0% font, 20% from the bottom, NO pill, NO shadow (default 5-words/4.5%/18% is too dense). Built in cue_builder.py within build_master.py.

end_card._comment: gpt-image-2 9:16 flat-lay still of the 5 products on pale stone, ken-burns held ~4.2s at the tail (27.80 -> 32.00). Do NOT trust the flat-lay's AI sublines for taglines — PDP-verify (see products[]).

vo.note: the SEPARATE locked ElevenLabs VO (atempo 1.15x) narrates the routine and drives every cut

product_cards.note: 5 Playwright cards (real cutout + PDP tagline), each on its product-NAME word-start

music.note: warm instrumental bed ducked under the VO, loudnorm I=-14

captions.note: clean-white, 3 words/cue, 3.0% font, 20% margin, no pill/shadow

end_card.note: gpt-image-2 flat-lay still of the 5 products, ken-burns held ~4s
